title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
shortDescription: A time-spanning adventure that pairs a memorable world with deliberate dungeon design, tool-based discovery, and a strong sense of place.
highlights: Dungeon tools that reshape how familiar spaces are read
A wide Hyrule journey framed by a clear coming-of-age arc

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A high-confidence Nintendo 64 adventure anchor: its exploration, dungeon pacing, and contextual tools make the platform’s 3D ambitions easy to understand.
